gift-halo.name: Broken Halo
gift-halo.creator: Unknown ancient maker; Yale University Art Gallery / Yale Digital Dura-Europos Archive
gift-halo.changes: Manual contour mask and optical crop; original accession label/background removed; resized to512px WebP.
gift-halo.alt: A photographed, open-ended ancient bronze ring with a dark weathered surface; an archaeological reinterpretation of Broken Halo.

gift-orchid.name: Midnight Orchid
gift-orchid.creator: Filo gèn'
gift-orchid.changes: Black backdrop made transparent with a deterministic colour key; optical crop and512px WebP conversion.
gift-orchid.alt: A real purple orchid blossom with five broad petals, yellow throat and a folded lower lip, photographed against black.

gift-signal.name: Sealed Signal
gift-signal.creator: Simon A. Eugster
gift-signal.changes: Manual mask isolates the original top envelope; crop, transparent canvas and512px WebP conversion.
gift-signal.alt: A cream envelope sealed with a red wax imprint, cropped from a human-photographed sealing-wax still life.

gift-ticket.name: Afterhours Ticket
gift-ticket.creator: William Weaver Tomlinson (1915 book); historical ticket maker unknown
gift-ticket.changes: Main ticket panel cropped from the1915 book illustration, excluding its caption; optical padding and512px WebP conversion.
gift-ticket.alt: A scanned historical Hull and Selby Railway first-class paper ticket and its original engraved typography.

gift-pocket-doomer.name: Pocket Doomer
gift-pocket-doomer.creator: Petey21
gift-pocket-doomer.changes: Manual photographic silhouette mask; ordinary per-channel desaturation/dark colour grading of clothing; crop and512px WebP conversion. This is a knitted mascot reinterpretation, not an exact canonical Doomer likeness.
gift-pocket-doomer.alt: A small human-made knitted mascot in a cap, photographed by its maker; the cap and clothing are conventionally graded charcoal.

gift-orbit-mobile.name: Orbit Mobile
gift-orbit-mobile.creator: Rama
gift-orbit-mobile.changes: Near-white backdrop removed by deterministic colour key; optical crop and512px WebP conversion. The source is an orrery, presented as the object base for Orbit Mobile.
gift-orbit-mobile.alt: A photographed brass-and-steel mechanical orrery with multiple curved orbital rings and a dark decorated base.

gift-last-broadcast.name: Last Broadcast
gift-last-broadcast.creator: Joe Haupt  from USA
gift-last-broadcast.changes: Manual photographic object mask; crop, transparent canvas and512px WebP conversion. Original product markings retained.
gift-last-broadcast.alt: A real blue Conion CR-2A pocket transistor radio with woven speaker grille, printed dial, red side controls and top handle.

gift-night-lantern.name: Night Lantern
gift-night-lantern.creator: S. J. Shaw & Co. (1860 object); Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum
gift-night-lantern.changes: Manual photographic silhouette mask; optical crop and512px WebP conversion. Glass appearance and original strap retained.
gift-night-lantern.alt: An1860 brass-and-glass conductor lantern with its actual woven carrying strap and curved metal carrier, photographed for Cooper Hewitt.

processing: Conventional Pillow photographic masks, optical crops, colour key, clothing colour grading and resampling only; no generative model.
